items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 19 October 2026 at 5:10pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Shallow low pressure over France, driving a front into the area tomorrow.


##Wind##

Southeast 3 to 5, becoming South or Southeast later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Rain spreads from the east overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southeast 3 to 5, becoming South or Variable 2 to 4 overnight into Wednesday, then increasing Northwest 5 to 7 Wednesday morning. Backing West or Northwest 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate Wednesday morning.


##Weather##

Rain clearing eastwards tomorrow night, with further rain then spreading from the west overnight into Wednesday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
